comments.author: benjy20
comments.body: Where I can get it? please :3

comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body:
Port Royal's item shop for the red version. It's era specific, but I found it with an Adept of Ages 17th Century, period 4 title equipped. And there's a notoriety requirement of 7k to equip or layer it. Sigh!

Now if you want the blue version, that takes a sewing recipe which I cannot recall the details of, and I have yet to find a purple one... though I hope to. Anybody else know about those versions, by chance?

comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body:
The blue colored version is made with a sewing town's man recipe with the barmaid at the tavern in Port Royal. Again your need the Adept of Ages 17th century period 4 title equipped (not sure if it works with other time periods). Your also need R12 sewing, 10 Feathers, 30 Satin, and 3 Suede to make it. It too requires notoriety to equip, up to 8.5k this time.

And the purple colored version is a [rare] drop from beating William
Kid in Ganador. Unlike the first two hats, this one gives boosters (+2 to Gunfire and +2 to Surgery), and doesnt need notoriety to equip.

comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: I saw a bright red version of this hat in the game recently. Does anyone know what it is, and how it compares to the other piratey bicorne hats here?

comments.author: CaliCaddy
comments.body:
You might be referring to a Salvager Bicorne. 40 Durability/5 disguise/20 defence/+1 Salvage/+1 Evasion/+2 Wining and Dining. Required fame 10000.

Obtained by raising shipwrecks.

comments.author: BonnyLass
comments.body: I see, thank you very much. Sounds lovely! I'll look forward to finding such a wreck myself, in the future.
